bibl.title: Excavations at the Monastery of St Antony at the Red Sea.
bibl.seg: Jesper Blid, Fr. Maximous El-Antony, Hugo Lundhaug, Jason Zaborowski, Meira Polliack, Mengistu Gobezie Worku & Samuel Rubenson, Excavations at the Monastery of St Antony at the Red Sea.
bibl.note: Introduction (J.Bl.). - The excavation and restoration work at the Church of the Holy Apostles: The excavation and restoration project (M.El-A.); - The first church (J.Bl. & M.El-A.); - The "cells" (J.Bl. & M.El-A.); - Documentation and restoration (M.El-A.). - Stratigraphy (J.Bl.). - Chronology (J.Bl.). - Finds (J.Bl.): The pottery; - Lithic materials; - Organic materials; - Metals; - Wall paintings. - Catalogue (J.Bl.). - The Coptic manuscripts (H.L.). - The Arabic manuscripts (J.Z.). - Hebrew Masoretic text of Lamentations 2:20-22 and Judaeo-Arabic translation of Lamentations 2:19-21 (M.P.). - The Ge'ez manuscript (M.G.W.). - The monastery in literary sources during the period under study (S.R.). - Summary (J.B.).
